description: This file is a JavaScript source script used for generating C# API interface code from API documentation. It processes API definitions, types, enums, and generates corresponding C# classes, interfaces, and enums, including handling of documentation and code templates.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Generates a C# file with specified class or interface, including documentation and code body.

methods.name: renderClass
methods.description: Renders a C# class or interface from a documentation class object, including members and documentation.

methods.name: renderModelType
methods.description: Generates a C# class for a given documentation type, handling properties.

methods.name: renderEnum
methods.description: Creates a C# enum from a list of string literals.

methods.name: renderOptionType
methods.description: Generates a C# class for option types, including constructors and members.

methods.name: toArgumentName
methods.description: Converts parameter name 'event' to '@event' for C# syntax.

methods.name: toMemberName
methods.description: Converts a documentation member to a C#-friendly member name, optionally appending 'Async'.

methods.name: toTitleCase
methods.description: Converts a string to TitleCase.

methods.name: renderConstructors
methods.description: Creates constructor code for a C# class.

methods.name: renderMemberDoc
methods.description: Renders documentation comments for a class member.

methods.name: renderMember
methods.description: Renders a class member (property, method, event) into C# code.

methods.name: getPropertyOverloads
methods.description: Generates property overloads for different JSON property names.

methods.name: generateNameDefault
methods.description: Generates default C# type or name for a documentation type, handling enums, objects, arrays, etc.

methods.name: generateEnumNameIfApplicable
methods.description: Determines if a type can be represented as an enum based on its union values.

methods.name: renderMethod
methods.description: Renders a method signature in C#, including async handling, parameters, and documentation.

methods.name: translateType
methods.description: Translates a documentation type into a C# type string, handling generics, unions, arrays, functions, and primitives.

methods.name: registerModelType
methods.description: Registers a documentation type as a model type for code generation.

methods.name: printArgDoc
methods.description: Outputs XML documentation for method parameters.

methods.name: toAsync
methods.description: Converts a method name to its async variant by appending 'Async'.

methods.name: rewriteSuggestedOptionsName
methods.description: Normalizes certain option type names to a common name.
